name: hiremind-ai
description: AI-powered career preparation platform for interviews, resumes, performance analysis, and personalized learning roadmaps.

scripts.backend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "GATEWAY,AUTH,INTERVIEW,RESUME,ROADMAP,BILLING" "npm run dev --prefix backend/gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/interview-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/resume-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/roadmap-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/billing-service"
